# Elite World Estates

> Polish real estate agency in Spain, operating since 2018. Sells sea view apartments, villas, townhouses and luxury villas on the Costa Blanca and Costa del Sol. The team speaks Polish, German, English and Spanish. Slogan: "Home is your castle!"

Contact: +34 672 519 809 · info@eliteworldestates.com

- [Modern Townhouses for Sale in Mutxamel, Alicante](https://www.eliteworldestates.com/properties/modern-townhouses-for-sale-in-mutxamel-alicante.html): new build development of 56 townhouses, 3–4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, 190 m² built, 2 underground parking spaces, communal pool, gym and social club, from €440,000. - [Property and Wealth Taxes in Spain – What Owners Pay Each Year](https://www.eliteworldestates.com/property-and-wealth-taxes-in-spain): Which taxes you pay as a property owner in Spain in 2026: IBI, non-resident income tax (also when you do not rent), wealth tax, the large fortunes tax and tax when you sell. German and Spanish versions under /de-de/ and /es-es/.

- [Squatters in Spain (Okupas) – Is There Anything to Fear When Buying Property?](https://www.eliteworldestates.com/squatters-in-spain-is-there-anything-to-fear-when-buying-property): How common are squatters (okupas) in Spain, what the law says since the 2025 fast-track reform, and how to protect a holiday home on the Costa Blanca or Costa del Sol. - [Staying in Spain for More Than 90 Days While Owning Property](https://www.eliteworldestates.com/staying-in-spain-for-more-than-90-days-while-owning-property): Owning a home in Spain does not give you the right to live there. What EU and non-EU (including UK) owners need to stay more than 90 days: registration, visas, tax residency, healthcare and cars. German and Spanish versions under /de-de/ and /es-es/.
